Name: Better Pelican Town Map
Author: deleted84683283
Description:
[size=3]This  mod changes 3 things in town :
- It adds a staircase north of the river so that there is no dead end.
- It changes the small area above JojaMart so that it's less useless but still pretty useless.
- It fixes the very annoying staircase leading to the pathway going to Robin's place so that the tiles aren't seemingly cut straight because of bad tiling.

[/size]It is recommended that you use this mod on a new save but if you choose otherwise, you should download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url] as there might be some Bushes in the way.

The code of this mod has been copied from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/105169983]ActionJackson's[/url] mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7510]Optimized Mining Map[/url]. I don't know if he wrote the code or if it came from some sort of template.

I will probably not update this mod except if there is a big issue with it.

Have fun!
